'''Ryamn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who worked for the [[Death's Claw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] as a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], Ryamn became a legal [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] sometime before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Sometime after that, he became entangled with the [[Death's Claw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization, and began to work as the group's doctor on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameLS}}
When Doctor [[Ianna Cel]] asked a Republic-allied individual to recover a sample of [[rakghoul serum]] from the pirates, the individual fought their way through the pirates' base and found the infirmary. Before they could take the serum, Ryamn warned them not to take it, or the rakghoul-infected pirates in the medbay would transform and attack. Ryamn convinced the individual to leave the serum by telling them that he found it in the ruins of [[Dynamet General Hospital]]. The individual left Ryamn the serum, warning the Twi'lek that they would come back if they couldn't find it.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ryamn was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears in the Taris mission "Pirate Medicine" for Republic players. Players can choose to leave the serum for light side points, or they can take it for dark side points. If they take it, they are forced to fight all of the infected pirates.<ref name="TOR" />
